method: Voxel occupancy + distance-field offset + binary closing/fill + smoothed signed-distance marching cubes
rhino_equivalence: Shrink-wrap-style approximation; Rhino 8 proprietary ShrinkWrap internals are not reproduced or validated.
topology_validation: Closed-edge, vertex-manifold and orientability checks; full global triangle self-intersection search is not run. Surface construction uses topology-preserving Lewiner marching cubes.
limitations: Offset, gap closing, enclosed-void filling and crop-end caps infer unobserved geometry.
This is a canopy/solid proxy, not measured trunk diameters, biomass, leaf area or validated CFD geometry.
The closed canopy wrap is watertight; the ground sheet and combined canopy-plus-ground scene are open.
Nearby leaves/branches/trees can be merged at the chosen scale. Small isolated components are removed.
Existing cross-row registration uncertainty remains; the wrap does not correct it.
